metadata.description: Film SiO2; Deposited by e-beam evaporation on c-Si at 25 °C; 878.4 nm thick film with a fine polycrystalline structure containing water and organic adsorbed contaminants in pores; Heterogenous data processing combining ellipsometric and spectrophotometric measurements; Room temperature.
